detail.title: Path Dependence and Preference Formation in Adaptive Systems
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the emergence of stable preferences through memory-dependent decision-making and path-dependent processes, integrating recent literature evidence.

detail.title: Path Dependence and Preference Formation
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
detail.reason: Continuing active investigation under the emergent_preferences topic.
